Class Terminal<B extends Backend>

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.terminal.Terminal<B>
Type Parameters:
B - the backend type
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class Terminal<B extends Backend> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The main terminal abstraction. Manages the rendering lifecycle and buffer management for efficient updates.
